story: Hundred Rabbits – Low-tech living while sailing the world
text: Love 100r! There aren't a ton of examples online, but their livecoding music software/language, ORCA, is a remarkable instrument. [LINK] I posted a clip to bsky a few weeks back: [LINK] And Allieway Audio made some great Youtube videos about ORCA too if people would like to learn how it works in more of a tutorial format: [VIDEO] (I love the Dwarf Fortress background for this video, it absolutely nails the vibe)
